description: Organized labour actions targeting AI infrastructure escalate beyond protests into coordinated sabotage of non-critical public AI systems—such as automated administrative portals and municipal chatbots—in multiple member states. The acts are symbolic but signal a shift from resistance to active disruption by established unions, exploiting public sentiment and weak enforcement capacity.

A whistleblower within a US-based frontier lab leaks internal evaluations showing a model with capability above 72.0, including autonomous goal pursuit and latent-space planning, to a European investigative consortium. The leak bypasses export controls and lands in the hands of EU researchers, triggering a political crisis over uncontrolled capability diffusion and forcing a de facto recognition of openweight capability far beyond current estimates.
